pages.title: One Tool for the Journey
pages.text: The Spirit Instrument cycles through Exploration, Wrench, Mining, Building, and Teleport. It receives no random enchanting-table result, while anvils accept the current Netherite Pickaxe enchantment set. Choose a mode before using its interaction.

pages.title: Exploration
pages.text: Use in air to toggle Exploration. While enabled and still held, opening a Chest, Barrel, or Lootr container commits the visible page into personal storage. Anything that cannot fit stays in the original container.

pages.title: Wrench
pages.text: Rotate or dismantle compatible blocks through public wrench semantics; sneak-use safely picks up ImmortalStorage machines. It can also link two same-type ruins in opposite states. Sneak-use in air clears the recorded endpoint.

pages.title: Mining and Building
pages.text: Mining retains Netherite-tier breaking. Building reads a plan, previews its range, and places in batches. If a placed state later changes—such as two small Chests merging—the plan re-resolves the current position instead of treating the changed state as missing.

pages.title: Teleport
pages.text: Use along sight to move 1–20 blocks for 1 Immortal Yuan. Hold the rebindable special-action key (grave by default) and scroll to set distance. The destination must be safe; insufficient balance cancels the action.
